user_saw: When credential removal overlapped a config reload, the operator could be told to restart the Gateway even though the model publication had been replaced.
summary: Gateway hot reload now treats a superseded model publication as cancellation even while its config application is still current, and still schedules recovery for genuine build failures.
reasoning: The blamed commit added a partial exception to an existing restart handler, so its config-currentness check left the reported case broken. The earlier credential-removal PR reports passing coverage for overlapping writes, and a later publication change added a typed rejection when a refresh loses ownership without a current successor. The available diffs do not establish which change first sent this credential-removal sequence through the restart handler.
